text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia and neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild anemia. There is also mild hypoglycemia and elevated monocyte and basophil percentages. These findings may suggest bone marrow suppression or an underlying hematologic or infectious process. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
